title: The Bright lamp on the desk
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：bright　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bright 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the doctor wrote of ① a bright lamp on the desk in the chart, and everybody in the clinic said at once that it was ② brighter than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the doctor, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the bright ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the brightest lamp on the desk anybody in the clinic had ever seen, or so the chart for January 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too bright to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the patient who had come to help; the bright ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a bright boy in the front row, and said that no patient in his right mind would call it ⑥ as bright as the boy in the front row they had once had in the old clinic. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was bright or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was ⑦ something bright, and nothing besides. The patient from the next clinic called the whole plan ⑧ quite bright; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the chart kept the names of the bright ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, for the whole place, she wrote of another bright lamp on the desk in the same chart, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ brighter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The brightest boy in the front row in the whole clinic, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the bright ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 明亮（前置定语 a bright lamp on the desk：1978 年大夫在病历里记下的那件明亮的灯）
B. adj. 明亮／聪颖（比较级 brighter than：文中两处，一处比桌上的灯，一处比预想）
C. adj. 明亮／聪颖（最高级 the brightest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 明亮（表语 too bright to do：母亲觉得它太明亮，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 聪颖（前置定语 a bright boy in the front row：叔叔把整件事称作一桩聪颖的男孩）
F. adj. 聪颖（同级比较 as bright as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩前排的男孩相比）
G. adj. 聪颖（后置定语 something bright：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 聪颖（受程度副词修饰 quite bright：那位病人的评价）

items.q: a bright lamp on the desk
the brightest lamp on the desk anybody
a bright boy in the front row
The brightest boy in the front row in

answers.why: bright 意为“明亮”，1978 年大夫在病历里记下的是“一件明亮的灯”，此处作前置定语 a bright lamp on the desk。
bright 意为“明亮”，此处用比较级 brighter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
bright 意为“明亮”，病历上 一月 那行字说它是卫生所里最明亮的一件，故用最高级 the brightest lamp on the desk。
bright 意为“明亮”，母亲认为这件东西“太明亮了，谁也用不上”，too bright to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
bright 意为“聪颖”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩聪颖的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a bright boy in the front row。
bright 意为“聪颖”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩前排的男孩一样聪颖”，同级比较用 as bright as。
bright 意为“聪颖”，病历上那半行字要的是“聪颖的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something bright。
bright 意为“聪颖”，邻卫生所来的那位病人认为这套计划“相当聪颖”，quite 修饰原级 bright。
bright 意为“聪颖”，1988 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要聪颖”，故用比较级 brighter than。
bright 意为“聪颖”，母亲 1990 年说的是“整个卫生所里最聪颖的那一桩”，故用最高级 the brightest boy in the front row。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，大夫在病历里记下了一件明亮的灯。（a bright lamp on the desk）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更明亮。（brighter than …）
母亲觉得它太明亮，谁也用不上。（too bright to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩聪颖的男孩。（a bright boy in the front row）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩前排的男孩一样聪颖。（as bright as …）
到了 1985 年，病历上只剩半行字：要的是一件聪颖的东西。（something bright）
answers: In 1978 the doctor wrote of a bright lamp on the desk in the chart.
Everybody said it was brighter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too bright to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a bright boy in the front row.
He said nobody would call it as bright as the boy in the front row they had once had.
By 1985 the chart asked for nothing but something bright.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bright 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the doctor wrote of a bright lamp on the desk in the chart, and nobody forgot it.
It was the brightest lamp on the desk in the clinic, or so the chart says.
My mother thought it too bright to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a bright boy in the front row, and nobody argued with him.
The patient from the next clinic called the plan quite bright, and everybody laughed.
The bright ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
